blocks.content:
EXIGÉS
PAR LES DIVERS PAYS
Amendement à la « Liste des certificats de vaccination exigés aux frontières » au 61 décembre I960

summary.text: A short French notice amending WHO's list of vaccination certificates required at borders, as of 31 December 1950.

blocks.title: INOCULATION AND VACCINATION CERTIFICATES REQUIRED BY VARIOUS COUNTRIES
blocks.content:
CERTIFICATES
REQUIRED BY VARIOUS COUNTRIES
Amendments of the “ List of Countries’ Inoculation 
and Vaccination Certificate R equirem ents” as on 
61 December 1950 (W HO/Qf28.Rev 1).
Oeéanle — Oceania
GUAM
La liste des certificats de vaccination exiges des 
voyageurs aru v an t à Guam a ete publiée dans le 
R E H N a 111 du 9 feviier 1949.
Une note publiée dans le R E H N° 615 du 
28 lévrier 1951 a signalé que les certificats de vaccination contre la peste et contre le typhus exanthém atique n'étaient plus exigés et qu’il lallait modifier en consequence les indications données dans la 
u Liste

summary.text: A bilingual French and English notice amending the list of inoculation and vaccination certificates required by various countries, covering Guam in Oceania. It records that plague and typhus certificates are no longer required and that civilian passengers arriving directly from the United States and its territories are exempted from medical and vaccination certificates from February 1951.
